# Run summary-presence health (ISI-7088 / ISI-7096)
Every completed run owes the thread **exactly one** `kind='summary'` comment — the agent authors it, or the platform synthesizes one in the terminal settle (ISI-7094). This dashboard is the observability layer + **regression guard** for that invariant.

- **Missing-summary** (red tile) is the whole-feature regression guard — it must stay **0**. The sibling Davis detector (`run-summary-presence-detector.json`) alerts on any non-zero value.
- **Source** = who put the summary on the thread: `agent` (self-authored), `synthesized` (platform fallback), `absent` (**regression** — no summary).

> ⚠️ Skeleton pending live-data validation (ISI-7096 follow-up). Metrics flow once an operator carrying ISI-7096 is deployed and a run completes. Empty tiles = *not yet measurable*, not a failure.

1.title: ⚠ Completed runs with NO summary (must be 0)
1.query: timeseries missing = sum(ksquad.run.summary.present, filter: { present == "false" }), from:-1h | fieldsAdd missing_total = arraySum(missing)

2.title: Summary presence rate (target 100%)
2.query: timeseries present = sum(ksquad.run.summary.present, filter: { present == "true" }), total = sum(ksquad.run.summary.present), from:-1h | fieldsAdd rate = 100.0 * arraySum(present) / arraySum(total)

3.title: Completed runs observed (liveness)
3.query: timeseries runs = sum(ksquad.run.summary.present), from:-1h | fieldsAdd runs_total = arraySum(runs)

5.title: Completed runs by outcome + source
5.query: timeseries runs = sum(ksquad.run.summary.present), by:{outcome, source}, filter:{in(outcome, array($outcome))}, from:-6h

6.title: Summary length p50 / p99 by source (chars)
6.query: timeseries len_p50 = percentile(ksquad.run.summary.length, 50), len_p99 = percentile(ksquad.run.summary.length, 99), by:{source}, from:-6h
